title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
summary: OpenAI has announced that its frontier models including GPT-4o and Codex are now available on AWS through Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker, enabling enterprise customers to access these models within their existing AWS infrastructure.
problem_solved: Addresses enterprise accessibility and integration challenges by bringing OpenAI's most powerful models directly to AWS customers' existing cloud infrastructure.
why_valuable: This partnership significantly expands access to OpenAI's frontier models for enterprise users who prefer AWS, reducing friction in adoption and enabling seamless integration with AWS services and security compliance.
